address: Lieu-dit de Bourgeac, 1 chemin de l'Ancienne-Voie-Ferrée, Paradou, 13520, France
bio: What a pleasure it is to take a seat in this establishment where you are welcomed naturally and simply by a Burgundian family. In this charming restaurant, the chef concocts subtle and delicate dishes, sprinkled with Provençal innuendo. The patio, next to the swimming pool and surrounded by Mediterranean vegetation, invites you to slow down and take things easy. An oasis of peace and charm....
